name: Device Calendar
description: Enables AI and slash commands to create, view, and schedule native calendar events on the phone.
author: Chattree Core Team
changelog: 1.0.1: Fix critical permission flow bug — plugin now correctly requests calendar.create permission before accessing the calendar. Previously caused permission denied on every invocation.

tools.description: Schedule a new event in the device calendar: /calendar add <title> | <startDate> [| <endDate>] [| <description>]
List events in the device calendar for a date range: /calendar-list <startDate> <endDate>

settings.label: Default Calendar Identifier
settings.description: Target calendar ID for scheduled events ('primary' uses the system default).

settings.label: Default Duration (Minutes)
settings.description: Default event duration in minutes if no end time is specified.
